about: Blackfalds is a town in central Alberta between Lacombe and Red Deer on the Queen Elizabeth II Highway corridor. Rapid residential growth, proximity to Red Deer, and a mix of new suburbs and prairie-town roots define the community. About 10,000 people live in Blackfalds.
seoSummary: Central Alberta town between Lacombe and Red Deer—fast-growing QEII corridor community north of Red Deer.
